title: Ninja Maker
description:
Ninja Maker is a 3D platformer game that you can create your own levels. Unleash your creativity and design the levels of your dreams!Campaign:Explore 5 worlds with 25 different levels. Find all the collectibles while fighting with various enemies. Be careful! At the end of every world, a boss fight waiting for you!Create, Play and Share:Build levels however you want! Add blocks, enemies, coins, obstacles, traps and others. Share your levels and play other levels created by players around the world.Block-Based Programming:Make your own gameplay by adding logic to blocks.GachaponCollect coins to buy gachapons and unlock new characters.Features• Fun combat: fight various enemies with your katana and shuriken

• Discover secrets with an 360° interactive camera

• 5 worlds and 25 different levels

• Block-based programming

• Level editor
description_short: Ninja Maker is a 3D platformer game that you can create your own levels. Unleash your creativity and design the levels of your dreams!
